name: How do I know if my door hardware needs adjustment or replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my door hardware needs adjustment or replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your door hardware is sticking, squeaking, or not latching properly, it likely needs adjustment. Signs like visible damage, excessive rust, or a complete failure to operate indicate a need for replacement. For issues like a loose doorknob or a misaligned strike plate, adjustment can often resolve the problem. If the core components are worn or broken, replacement is usually the better option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Adjust if sticking or squeaking; replace if damaged, rusted, or completely inoperable.
